overseer.name: OVERSEER
overseer.hint: Shields itself every few seconds: hold the Pulse until the shield drops

broodmother.name: BROODMOTHER
broodmother.hint: Spawns spores at every 25% of HP lost: keep damage spread to clear the brood

siphon.name: SIPHON
siphon.hint: Drains Energy and heals on every hit: kill it before it reaches the core

swarmlord.name: SWARM LORD
swarmlord.hint: Shields every virus near it: thin the swarm or burst the lord first

artillery.name: ARTILLERY
artillery.hint: Shells the core from the edge: buy Range or let turrets reach it

mutagen.name: MUTAGEN
mutagen.hint: Forces a mutation on arrival and speeds up below half HP: burst it down
